description: Standard and custom events posted to the Branch Events API on api2.branch.io.

params.name: branch_key
params.description: It is the Branch Key for the application, and the Events API requires it.
params.fix_hint: Send the Branch Key from Account settings or Configuration, Security and Access.

params.name: name
params.description: It is the event name. On `/v2/event/standard` it must be a documented Branch standard event; `/v2/event/custom` accepts any name.
params.fix_hint: Set `name` to a standard event such as `PURCHASE`, or post a custom name to `/v2/event/custom`.

params.name: user_data
params.description: Branch requires a `user_data` object with device and identity fields.
params.fix_hint: Add `user_data` with at least one documented identifier.

params.name: user_data.ip
params.description: It is the device IP address where the event occurred, sent unhashed.
params.fix_hint: Send the device IP, not a digest.

params.name: user_data.developer_identity
params.description: Developer-specified identity for the user. Branch requires at least one documented identifier in `user_data`.

params.name: user_data.browser_fingerprint_id
params.description: Branch browser fingerprint. One of the identifiers that can satisfy the identity requirement.

params.name: user_data.idfa
params.description: iOS advertising ID. Branch requires it together with `os=iOS` when it is the identifier in use.

params.name: user_data.idfv
params.description: iOS vendor ID. Branch requires it together with `os=iOS` when it is the identifier in use.

params.name: user_data.android_id
params.description: Android hardware ID. Branch requires it together with `os=Android` when it is the identifier in use.

params.name: user_data.aaid
params.description: Android advertising ID. Branch requires it together with `os=Android` when it is the identifier in use.

params.name: user_data.user_agent
params.description: It is the user agent of the browser or app where the event occurred, sent unhashed.

params.name: user_data.country
params.description: It is the user's country code, usually from device settings. Branch's Events API sample is a two-letter code such as `US`.
params.fix_hint: Send a two-letter country code such as `US`.

params.name: user_data.limit_ad_tracking
params.description: It is whether the partner opted out of advertiser tracking. Branch documents a boolean.

params.name: user_data.advertising_ids.oaid
params.description: It is the OAID inside `advertising_ids`. Branch documents a UUID for non-standard IDs such as Huawei OAID.

params.name: user_data.dma_eea
params.description: Whether European regulations, including the DMA, apply to this user. Branch documents it as a boolean.

params.name: user_data.dma_ad_personalization
params.description: Whether the user granted ads personalization consent. Branch documents it as a boolean, required when `dma_eea` is true.

params.name: user_data.dma_ad_user_data
params.description: Whether the user granted consent for third-party transmission of user-level ads data. Branch documents it as a boolean, required when `dma_eea` is true.

params.name: event_data.currency
params.description: It is the ISO 4217 currency that revenue, price, shipping, and tax were reported in.
params.fix_hint: Use a three-letter code such as `USD`.

params.name: event_data.revenue
params.description: It is the reported revenue for the event. Branch documents a number.
params.fix_hint: Send a number such as `129.99`, with no currency symbol.

params.name: event_data.shipping
params.description: It is the shipping cost for the transaction. Branch documents a number.
params.fix_hint: Send a number such as `10.5`, with no currency symbol.

params.name: event_data.tax
params.description: It is the total tax for the transaction. Branch documents a number.
params.fix_hint: Send a number such as `13.5`, with no currency symbol.

params.name: content_items[].$content_schema
params.description: It is the content schema on a `content_items` row. Branch documents a closed set of COMMERCE, GAME, MEDIA, TEXT, and OTHER values.
params.fix_hint: Set `content_items[].$content_schema` to a documented value such as `COMMERCE_PRODUCT`.

params.name: content_items[].$og_image_url
params.description: It is the image URL for the content item. Branch documents `$og_image_url` as a URL.
params.fix_hint: Send an absolute image URL in `content_items[].$og_image_url`, or omit the field.

params.name: content_items[].$condition
params.description: It is the product condition on a `content_items` row, used for auctions. Branch documents a closed set.
params.fix_hint: Set `content_items[].$condition` to `NEW`, `USED`, `REFURBISHED`, or another documented value.

rules.message: `user_data` carries none of the identifiers Branch requires. At least one of `developer_identity`, `browser_fingerprint_id`, `idfa`, `idfv`, `android_id`, or `aaid` must be present.
rules.fix_hint: Send `user_data.developer_identity`, or a platform advertising ID such as `idfa` or `aaid`.

rules.message: This field looks like a SHA-256 digest, but Branch documents `user_data.ip` and `user_data.user_agent` as unhashed.
rules.fix_hint: Send the raw IP address or user agent.

rules.message: `dma_eea` is true, but the event is missing `dma_ad_personalization` or `dma_ad_user_data`. Branch documents both consent signals when EU regulations apply.
